findings.text: the recorded commit 46c35918ab49c9a36b7f436f62378c5d81fdc72e does not exist; the source worktree's actual clean head is 46c35918a2b36ad23c7aa8a03db682e08688c396, so a coordinator following the durable receipt cannot resolve or promote the stated commit.

the 1,580.509-second compose gate was launched directly from the login-node worktree rather than through a debug-partition allocation; the retained command contains no srun, so the heavy-gate evidence violates the workstation compute contract and must be re-measured on SLURM before acceptance.

no committed regression test or receipt fixture asserts the four selected paths, the 3/4 rate, or the SNRun binding; the recorded audit-doc and marker greps are point-in-time structural checks and would not fail if these scientific facts later drifted.
